text:
The formula $\fn{Inf}(X) \ident$
\begin{multline*}
\lexists[u][(\lforall[x][\lforall[y][(\eq[u(x)][u(y)] \lif 
      \eq[x][y])]] \land {} \\\lexists[y][(X(y) \land \lforall[x][(X(x)
      \lif \eq/[y][u(x)])]])]
\end{multline*}
is satisfied with respect to a variable assignment~$s$ iff $s(X)$ is
infinite.
